async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the error; `void | Promise<void>` is the single Go error.
rationale: InMemoryTransport is mcptest.InMemoryTransport (upstream mcp/testing is Go mcp/mcptest). Closed as public-api-tested: a public test-double package that no PiG binary calls; the new tests drive its contract directly.

connectPeer.rationale: ConnectPeer(peer) error returns the `already has a peer` error where upstream throws.

onClose.rationale: OnClose is promoted from the embedded TransportEvents; the returned func disposes the listener.

close.rationale: InMemoryTransport.close is the Go method mcptest.InMemoryTransport.Close; signature reviewed against the upstream declaration (a Promise or rejection is the returned error; unknown error is Go error).
